outcome: cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise (CS-IFC)
cohort: 254 high-risk fetuses attending the day hospital unit of a tertiary referral hospital that underwent an ultrasound examination at 32-41 weeks and gave birth within 1 day of examination
finding: In this study of high-risk pregnancies, cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) measured within 24 hours of delivery was a moderate predictor of both adverse perinatal outcomes and cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise.
